title: Mapped-test ID manifest for decision-rule-v1 freeze precondition B-4 (CPO-R107)

derivation.primary: Expanded independently from quality.md §7.4 L1074–L1078 (the only place that enumerates all mapped tests with k_f and K=157), cross-checked against PLAN §4.4 L737/L742 and §13.1 PRQ-01..06, quality §3.2 L433/L438 (game streams excluded), and QR-60..63 / CPO-R107.
derivation.stream_set: PLAN L737 primitive streams, not the removed games-package streams at quality L433/L442.
derivation.n_rule: CPO-R107 B-3: n ≥ 10^9 public-call outcomes per usage per RC. One outcome = one public call (one permutation, one complete sample set, or one value).
derivation.per_test_alpha: 0.01/K = 0.01/157 ≈ 6.37e-5 (quality L1078), subject to HoQ recomputing if K'≠K.

outcome_definition: One outcome is the result of one public call: one full permutation for shuffle, one complete sample set for sample, one value for randomInt and weightedPick (CPO-R107 B-3).

differences.summary: HoQ referred to 'the PLAN L741 primitive stream set'. In the frozen PLAN 206e0511a76f… (1391 lines) the mapped stream set is at L737; L741 is the lab-matched Dieharder+NIST STS paragraph. This manifest cites L737 for the stream set.

PLAN L737 lists six randomInt usages — (0,2), (1,7), (1,38), (1,53), (0,100), (0,2^31+1) — plus a 52-card Lehmer shuffle and weighted {1,3,6}. It does not list sample, and it does not list randomInt [0,2^32), [0,38), [0,54), [0,2^32+1), [0,2^48). quality.md §7.4 L1074 (the per-usage mapped-test rows, post-P12 / engine-only) lists 11 randomInt usages, the six shuffle lengths, three sample (n,k) cases, and the W-A/W-B strips. A strict PLAN-L737-only expansion of the 6 GLI tests would be 6×6 + 6 + 6 = 48, plus whatever §13.1 adds, not 157. This manifest expands §7.4, which is the only source that enumerates K=157, and lists the PLAN-L737 extras as present, not dropped.
differences.effect_on_K: If those five randomInt usages were dropped, R would lose 5×6=30 tests (the two ordered-pair tests would remain), K'=127, not 157. They are kept because they are in §7.4.

differences.summary: quality.md §3.2 L433 still names the v5 game streams (the v5 game streams listed at quality.md §3.2 L433; not repeated here, rule 40) and L442 still puts QR-32/37/38/42 game statistics in the mapped Bonferroni family. Those were removed by P12 / R-75. They are NOT in this manifest. Shuffle lengths 104, 312, 416 (formerly shoe sizes) and 54 (52+2) are kept because PRQ-02 L1107 and §7.4 L1075 list them as generic shuffle lengths, not as named games.

quality.md L433, ignoring the removed game streams, has the PLAN L737 six plus [0,2^32), and a v5 addition of [0,38) and [0,54) — nine randomInt usages. §7.4 adds two more: [0,2^32+1) and [0,2^48). Those two are also in QR-63 golden/RC vectors (L1022) and PRQ-01 L1106 (r=2^48).

PRQ-01 L1106 and QR-63 L1022 require χ² + runs + serial correlation for r ∈ {2, 37, 38, 52, 100, 2^31+1, 2^48} — a 7-value set, and only three of the six GLI tests. That set is not identical to the 11 §7.4 usages: it omits r=6, 54, 2^32, 2^32+1, and it names r=37 without saying whether that is [0,37) or [1,38). §7.4 applies all six GLI tests to all 11 usages (including [1,38) for r=37) and puts ordered-pair χ² on randomInt(0,37) and randomInt(0,38) as two extra tests. This manifest follows §7.4 for K.
differences.effect_on_K: none (K follows §7.4, which already includes the PRQ-01 r values via the 11 usages plus the two ordered-pair tests)

differences.summary: The two ordered-pair tests are at r=37 and r=38. QR-63, remapped QR-38 and PRQ-06 name randomInt(0,37) and randomInt(0,38). randomInt(0,37) is not one of the 11 §7.4 GLI usages (those have [1,38) for r=37). This manifest uses min=0,max=37 and min=0,max=38 for the ordered-pair IDs, and does not add [0,37) as a 12th GLI-tested usage.
differences.effect_on_K: none (still exactly 2 extra R tests; K remains 68/157)

differences.summary: quality.md L438 and PRQ-02/PRQ-05 still say ≥10^8 outcomes (shuffles) in places. PLAN L742 and CPO-R107 B-3 require ≥10^9 public-call outcomes per usage per RC. Every entry in this manifest uses n=10^9. This is a parameter, not a K difference.

Independent expansion of quality.md §7.4 L1074–L1078: R 11×6+2=68, S 6+4+2+1+6=19, P (5+1+1)+(9+1+1)+(20+1+1)=40, W 6+2×(1+1+10)=30, K'=157. This matches HoQ's 157 (68/19/40/30). No tests were padded or trimmed to hit 157.
